summary: Pure graph algorithms: topological ordering (Kahn's algorithm), ancestor discovery (BFS), and parallel layer computation for DAG scheduling. Zero external dependencies. Used by PipelineSpec for step ordering.

key_functions.name: topological_order(nodes, edges, target=None)
key_functions.purpose: Kahn's algorithm with optional target-ancestor filtering; raises on cycles

key_functions.name: ancestors(edges, target)
key_functions.purpose: BFS backward from target; returns all ancestor nodes

key_functions.name: parallel_layers(edges, order)
key_functions.purpose: Groups topologically-ordered nodes into concurrent execution layers

lifecycle_notes: Minimal, stable, pure-function module with stdlib-only dependencies
